raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 duplicate txn_id values are exactly the 27 raw rows with record_version=2, which are restated versions of transactions that also have a record_version=1 row. silver_transactions keeps every version, so each restated transaction is counted twice downstream. The fix is to keep only the highest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter, so a restated status is respected.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
